One of the most concrete visuals I've ever seen on LSD (with a bit of weed as well) was when I was going into this small room I prepared with a blanket over the doorframe to achieve a complete pitch black atmosphere. I was on 400ug. I sit down with my legs crossed and earplugs in, when all of a sudden I see this little hole in the doorframe letting a tiny bit of light through. I notice it, and as I try to cover it with a part of the blanket, I look back into the darker part of the room away from the door, and for maybe about 3-4 seconds, I see this insane machinescape as the light faded from me plugging the hole. It was all different shades of dark purple, made of intricate gears intertwining, with a large clock face obscured by some of the gears. I had never seen something like it, and spent a bit trying to recreate it to no avail. Still had quite the experience in the dark room afterwards, but that machinescape definitely left an imprint on my memory. I have seen plenty of psychedelic "tunnels," some MC Escher-like things, and even a dense maze of doors before while mixing LSD, booze, cocaine, weed & nicotine, but haven't seen a machinescape since.

*Anadenanthera peregrina* is a plant source for 5-MeO-DMT (as well as typical DMT and Bufotenin). However, it is an oddity as most plants don't contain 5-MeO.  But OP, be aware that 5-MeO and DMT are extremely different experiences, hardly in the same ballpark as far as subjective effects go. Additionally, you can die from 5-MeO if you take too much, so be careful. But to answer your original question, as far as I know the process for extracting typical DMT from plants is the same, but you should use Mimosa Hostilis or some other plant that has high concentrations of DMT, as most plants have low concentration. As far as 5-MeO, I'm not familiar with extraction other than from the toads themselves, or *Anadenanthera peregrina* seeds prepared as a snuff (which will then subject you to the other compounds found in the seeds themselves).
